text:
alexa: morning team — we're seeing a concentrated reconnect spike in eu-west around 09:17 UTC. appears right after a key rotation window. clients open SSE, get a brief 401, then immediately hammer reconnects.

tom: any reproducible trace? resume tokens or fresh sessions?

alexa: mostly resume flows. quick log example: 
```
[09:17:02] GET /v1/stream resume_id=resume-42 tenant=bigco -> 401
[09:17:02] proxy: keyring rotating (hold)
[09:17:03] auth-svc validate resume_id=resume-42 -> 200
[09:17:03] SSE started -> client sees EOF -> reconnect loop
```

jamal: that ~1s stall on proxy keyring refresh is the culprit. with hundreds of concurrent streams it becomes a thundering herd.

lina: short-term mitigations we discussed: 1) proxy returns 503 + Retry-After when rotation-flag is set so clients back off 2) push SDK guidance for jittered reconnect backoff (suggest 400-1200ms randomized) 3) implement a lightweight server-side dedupe window (3-5s) keyed by resume_id to avoid duplicate billable sessions.

tom: returning 503 will change metric attribution; our billing pipeline treats reconnects differently. we should coordinate with billing so transient 503s don't create misleading spikes.

deploy-bot: incident INC-2026-887 created and assigned to tom.

jamal: long-term: move keyring refresh off hot path, maintain a hot standby cached token, and emit `keyring_refresh_block_ms` metric. I'll add an exporter and a dashboard panel.

alexa: dashboard note: current query is `sum(rate(sse_reconnect_total[5m])) by (region)`. propose adding `avg(auth_handoff_latency_ms) by (region, tenant)` and a tenant heatmap so SREs can quickly scope.

lina: UX idea: annotate streaming dashboard with deploy events and auto-scan for auth_handoff_latency p95 spikes during canary windows — surface an alert card automatically.

tom: plan: 1) feature-flagged proxy change to 503+Retry-After=10s -> canary 5% eu-west 2) SDK note & client-edge throttle 3) start exporter for keyring metric + add dashboard tile 4) dedupe implementation to avoid double billing.

jamal: I'll prototype dedupe as a tiny LRU cache with TTL 3s. low memory and simple.

alexa: can we choose Retry-After conservatively (10s) and make it configurable per-tenant? high-traffic tenants might need different backoff.

tom: agreed. also add a console alert that ties sse_reconnect_rate spikes to recent deploys touching auth components. Lina, can you own the annotation pipeline?

lina: yes — I'll wire deploy webhook -> 10m post-deploy scan of auth_handoff_latency_ms p95 and create an alert card if delta > threshold.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: proxy-rotation-backoff-canary -> 10:30 UTC (canary: 5% eu-west)

alexa: thanks team. please post canary metrics in this thread after 10:30. :thumbsup:

tom: watching: sse_reconnect_rate, auth_handoff_latency_ms, keyring_refresh_block_ms, billing_delta. finance alerted if billing delta exceeds 5%.
